action.description: Which write operation to perform — pass its matching params object (e.g. action: "send-message" pairs with sendMessage: {...}). send-* act on the user's LinkedIn account (linkedin:write); sync-chat only INGESTS a chat into a deal and needs linkedin:read.

chatId.description: Reply into this existing chat. Omit to start a NEW 1:1 with the target (provide providerId/url/personId).

providerId.description: Unipile provider id / member URN of the target (most direct).

url.description: Full LinkedIn profile URL of the target (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane).

personId.description: Cedar crm_person id of the target (resolved to a LinkedIn identifier server-side).

unipileAccountId.description: Unipile account id of the connected LinkedIn seat to act through. Omit to auto-use your single connected seat; if you have several, call list-seats and pass one.

note.description: LEAVE THIS UNSET. Connection requests are sent with no note by default — never add one on your own judgement, however good the note would be. Set it ONLY when the user has explicitly asked for a note on this request, and then set `noteRequestedByUser: true` alongside it or the send is refused.

noteRequestedByUser.description: The user explicitly asked for a note on this connection request. Required whenever `note` is set; never set it to justify a note the user did not ask for.

chatId.description: Send into this existing chat instead of addressing a new recipient.

conversationId.description: The EXISTING Cedar deal (crm_conversations id) to attach the LinkedIn chat to.

chatId.description: The LinkedIn chat id (from list-chats) to pull live and attach.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
